kjv: I will prepare him an habitation
note: 'anvehu is probably "I will praise/adorn him" (cf. naveh "beautiful"); the KJV derived it from naveh "abode".
Hebrew peleshet is the coastal land of the Philistines; "Palestina" suggests the much larger later Roman province.
'allufei are clan chiefs; "dukes" imports European nobility.

kjv: The people shall hear, and be afraid
mine: The peoples have heard; they tremble
note: The Hebrew perfects (shame'u) can be prophetic future or past; the KJV makes vv. 14-16 future, and mine reads them as accomplished.
